Package com.irurueta.authserver.bff.api.web.documents

package com.irurueta.authserver.bff.api.web.documents
Documents endpoints of the BFF (/api/documents), generated from the contract apis/bff/rest-server/bff-api-v1.yaml: they call the use cases, which reach the resource server through the documents port on the user's behalf.

  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    DocumentDtoMapper
    Maps the domain documents onto the DTO generated from the contract; a controller never returns a domain model.
    DocumentsController
    Lists and deletes the documents of the signed-in user, as the contract apis/bff/rest-server/bff-api-v1.yaml describes them through the generated DocumentsApi.
    DocumentsExceptionHandler
    Translates the failures of DocumentsController to RFC 9457 problem details.
    StepUpProblemMapper
    Maps a step-up request of the resource server onto the extra members of the step-up-required problem, the values the SPA passes back to GET /bff/login.
